And, there is a lot in return. Think of the many happy faces of customers when you arrive with your delivery van at their doorstep! 🚚

Curious about what other benefits you can expect? Read on! 👀

What we offer
- Earn € 18,83 per hour (from age 21)!
- A chance to get a contract with Albert Heijn!
- An informal work environment!
- Plan your own shifts via the app!
- Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, up to 45 km!
- Nice growth opportunities at Albert Heijn!

Who you are
As a delivery driver, your social skills come in very handy: you will be in touch with customers a lot! 😊 Also, physical work is no problem for you, such as lifting crates up to fifteen kilos. 💪 Additionally, you meet the following requirements:

- You have a valid B driving license (Min 2 Year)🚗
- You speak Dutch or English, or both

While driving around in your own van, you may encounter challenges. Like a building without an elevator or a hard-to-find house number. This makes your work varied and exciting! #baanrader 🤩 Fortunately, you’ll be well-prepared: you start your job with an extensive training guided by a buddy. This colleague will teach you exactly how to deliver groceries on time and neatly. 💪 Ready for more? You can grow internally to become a buddy or a team leader through internal training programs. 🚀

Where will you work

Are you looking for ultimate freedom on the road and weekly payments in your bank account? As a Delivery Driver AH Online in Leiden, you will enjoy independence and a great starting salary. Step into your office on wheels and make countless customers happy! 🚚💨💸

To get started as a Delivery Driver AH Online, it is important that you like to stay active. You know exactly how to navigate safely through the traffic in Leiden. Furthermore, you bring the following for this top job: 🚗💼🏃

Job application

- Internal training opportunities
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Bring a friend and get € 200!
- Travel expenses and pension plan
- A nice and fun working environment!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are customer-friendly. Lifting heavy crates up to 15 kilos is no problem for you! What else you need to know about this job:

- You have a B driving license (stick shift);
- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transport to get to the distribution center in Almere

What will you do
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, no day is the same. But that makes it fun! You start your day by checking your van. Everything ok? Time to get your tools and delivery routes for the day. You can find the Albert Heijn distribution center at Wormerweg 10 in Almere. This is easy to reach with your own transport! You and your colleagues leave from this location every day. Get to know them while drinking a cup of coffee together. What makes the work even more fun?

Where will you work

Are you someone who enjoys going to the gym during the day or prefers doing your grocery shopping when it's nice and quiet? Then a career as a Line Operator could be exactly what you're looking for!

Working in shifts gives you a flexible schedule, making it feel like you have an extra day off every week. Sounds good, right?

As a line operator, you are responsible for ensuring the production process runs smoothly in a modern manufacturing environment. You will set up, operate, and monitor production machines and equipment to ensure production is carried out safely, efficiently, and in line with quality standards.

You will keep a close eye on the production process, identify any irregularities, and take action when needed. You'll also troubleshoot minor machine issues independently and perform first-line maintenance to keep operations running smoothly. In addition, you will carry out quality inspections and accurately record production data.

In this role, you'll work closely with colleagues from production, logistics, and the technical department. Maintaining high standards of hygiene, safety, and quality is an essential part of the job and the working environment.

- Accurate and quality-conscious
- Results-driven, flexible, and proactive
- A team player
- Good command of Dutch or English

"An empty fridge doesn't make anyone happy, right?" As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you make sure customers get their favorite snacks, breakfast and groceries delivered right to their door. On top of that, you’ll score an all-in hourly wage of €18.83. Ka-chinggg!

With you behind the wheel, every delivery becomes a party! And you get paid well for it  too. With flexible working hours, almost anything is possible.

As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you deliver groceries right to the customer's front door. You are physically fit and have no problem lifting crates. You can also easily step in and out of the delivery van on a regular basis.

- You speak Dutch or English.

From well-known cities to tiny villages you didn't even know existed: that is what awaits you as an Albert Heijn delivery driver. Every day is different. Some days your workday runs smoothly, and other days you run into obstacles—like an apartment building without an elevator or a house number that's nowhere to be found. You’ll experience it all.

Fortunately, you are well-prepared during your onboarding period and you know how to keep a cool head! There are also plenty of opportunities to grow. For instance, you can quickly start working as a buddy, guiding and training new employees. Or you can become a plusser, making sure every driver hits the road fully equipped with all the essentials.
